notes.title: Minor update: Press the big red button to reset your progress
notes.notes:
Game change:
A big red button on the setting screen.

Recently, a few speedrunners found this game. (Which is a big surprise to me)
They demand this button to reset progress.

Check https://www.speedrun.com/yapp for their amazing runs.
Their discord server https://discord.gg/489xXBHfPS.



By the way, my latest game, Understand has been published on steam.
It's a line drawing puzzle inspired by The Witness, but you won't think it's a Witness clone or Witness lite.

notes.title: World 7 Update
notes.notes:
You take the blue noticeboard - the story ends, you quit the game and believe whatever you want to believe.
You take the red noticeboard - you stay in YAPP and I show you how deep the rabbit-hole goes.

(Actually, World 7 is painted grey. Anyway, it doesn't really matter.)

In case you are reading this without any idea of YAPP, here comes a short description for it:
YAPP: Yet Another Puzzle Platformer is a low-effort but well-designed puzzle game, with a casual but hard-core game experience, mainly inspired by Portal, Talos Principle and Braid.

Features:

    Seven new puzzles. Explore the potential power of the game mechanisms.
    New achievement / star not included. (World 7 is optional. You don't have to suffer from it if it makes you suffering.)
    A simple gamepad support. (Default key binding is for ps4 gamepad)
    1/5 and 1/10 timescale.
    Unity's default resolution dialog becomes available. (I have to admit mine is worse)
